GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ChatDefault.description: Global default chat model (R-9). Persisted in the `ChatDefaults` application settings section.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ChatTargetD.description:
A chat-dispatch target derived from the model catalog + assistant metadata
(R-9.2). Returned to the settings UI so users can pick which model an
assistant points at.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ChatTargetR.description:
Composed readiness for a chat target (R-9.2). GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ChatTargetReadinessDto.ReferenceKind is
`direct`, `defaultedTo`, or `overriddenToDefault` depending on
global default chat settings and assistant model configuration.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ConnectionU.description:
Consumers referencing a single provider connection section. Drives the
"Used by services" chips on the Connections tab (R-5.5 / R-8.1 consumer
visibility). GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ConnectionUsageDto.Modes lists every `ServiceModes` row whose
`ProviderSection` equals `{section}`; GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ConnectionUsageDto.ChatTargets
lists catalog models whose provider maps to `{section}` and that are
referenced by at least one active Assistant.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.Infrastruct.description:
Phase E (R-5.7): a single probe request item. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeRequestItemDto.Kind is
`"url"` or `"path"`. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeRequestItemDto.Id is an opaque caller-supplied
correlation id (usually the dependency key) so the response can be joined
back to the originating row. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeRequestItemDto.Target is the URL or filesystem
path to probe.

Phase E (R-5.7): a single probe result. The GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Kind discriminator
selects which fields are populated.

For `kind == "url"`: GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Reachable is true iff the server
answered with a non-5xx status. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.StatusCode carries the HTTP
status (null on transport failure). GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Exists / GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Writable
are null.
For `kind == "path"`: GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Exists is true iff the path
exists; GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Writable is true iff the path is a directory and a
sentinel file could be created+deleted. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Reachable /
GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.StatusCode are null.GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.InfrastructureProbeResultDto.Error carries a short diagnostic when the probe could not
succeed; never thrown out of the service.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.LlamaRuntim.description:
Phase F (R-6.10 / R-7.1): per-alias runtime status snapshot surfaced by
`GET /api/settings/llama/runtime/status`. Derived from existing
inventory + coordinator state — does not mutate any locks.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.LlamaRuntimeAliasStatusDto.Loaded mirrors the inventory runtime state
(`"loaded"` vs everything else). GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.LlamaRuntimeAliasStatusDto.InProgress is true iff a
load operation is currently being orchestrated through
`NotebookModelRuntimeService`. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.LlamaRuntimeAliasStatusDto.LastLoadStartedAt /
GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.LlamaRuntimeAliasStatusDto.LastLoadDurationMs / GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.LlamaRuntimeAliasStatusDto.LastError are populated
from the most recent terminal operation for this alias (if any).

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ModeReadine.description:
Composed readiness for a non-chat service mode (R-5.2 / R-7.1 composition).
Status is `ready` only when every component probe succeeded; otherwise
`blocked` with a non-empty GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.ModeReadinessDto.Blockers list.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsOve.description:
Overview composite returned by `GET /api/settings/overview`. Summarizes
service-mode readiness counts, chat-target readiness counts, provider
connection gaps, and local llama runtime state.

GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRun.description:
Runtime-owned dependency surfaced on the Infrastructure tab (R-5.7).
GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.Source — one of `appsettings`, `environment`, `compose`,
`user-secrets`, `unknown` — records which configuration provider
last wrote GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.CurrentValue. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.HasValue mirrors
GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.CurrentValue; it exists so callers that might mask
GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.CurrentValue (e.g. for secret-adjacent keys) can still tell
whether the key is present. GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.Kind discriminates the UI probe
strategy — `url` values get HEAD reachability probes, `path` values
get filesystem existence+writability probes, `other` is ineligible.
GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.IsSecret is set when GuideAntsApi.Models.Settings.SettingsRuntimeDependencyDto.CurrentValue is masked
server-side so the UI can render a "••••" placeholder instead of the literal.

GuideAntsApi.Services.HuggingFace.Huggin.description:
One file in an HF repository, categorized for the Add Model wizard.

`Category` is one of: `gguf` (downloadable llama-cpp quant),
`mmproj` (vision projector for multimodal llama-cpp models),
`other` (everything else: tokenizer configs, README, etc.).

Outcome of browsing an HF repository's file tree. All fields are safe to
echo to the browser; the HF token is NEVER included.
